title: CanonicalEvent
description: Canonical agent event — the normalized, single-event shape that open-agent-audit emits and maps onto an AEP record (aep-record). Each field has a direct aep-record counterpart: run_id/trace_id/created_at_ms/signature map 1:1; agent -> run_context; action -> actions[]; capability_decision -> capability_decisions[]; verifier_result -> verifier_results[].

schema_version.description: Wire version tag for the canonical event envelope.

event_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this single event within the run.

event_type.description: Discriminator naming which canonical payload this event carries.

run_id.description: The run this event belongs to. Maps to aep-record.run_id.

trace_id.description: Optional trace/correlation id. Maps to aep-record.trace_id.

parent_trace_id.description: Optional parent trace id for nested/delegated runs. Maps to aep-record.parent_trace_id.

created_at_ms.description: Unix-epoch milliseconds at which the event was recorded. Maps to aep-record.created_at_ms.

agent.description: Identity of the agent that produced the event. Maps to aep-record.run_context.

action.description: A single tool action. Maps to one entry of aep-record.actions[].

capability_decision.description: A capability allow/deny decision. Maps to one entry of aep-record.capability_decisions[].

verifier_result.description: A verifier pass/fail result. Maps to one entry of aep-record.verifier_results[].

payload.description: Free-form event-specific payload for event_type 'custom'. Ignored by the open-agent-audit -> aep-record adapter for typed event_types.

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the event. Maps to aep-record.signature.
